2608.22830.title: Beyond the Harness: End-to-End Optimization of Context Artifacts for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
2608.22830.paper_summary: Deploying LLMs for enterprise Text-to-SQL is bottlenecked less by the model than by what context reaches it: business logic spans thousands of tables, and no model can ingest a full catalog at once. We argue that the most effective place to intervene is therefore the \emph{knowledge-base context} the model consumes, and that this context should be \emph{constructed} from historical usage rather than tuned for as a fixed input. Using a query-DAG decomposition--the same family of intermediates that enterprise benchmarks like BEAVER annotate, here recovered from production SQL--we compare the value of oracle query graphs versus retrieved knowledge-base context. In this ablation, retrieved knowledge-base context provides the largest marginal improvement when added to the full oracle graph. Building on this, we optimize a distillation procedure that turns historical query profiles into reusable SQL reference cards. On a benchmark of 5176 production queries from a major online retailer, optimizing these context artifacts yields larger gains (${\sim}12$--$25\%$ AST similarity) than optimizing the retrieval harness (${\sim}3$--$12\%$). On the public BEAVER benchmark, which lacks the production-usage signals available in our internal setting, the picture is more mixed: table cards alone perform about the same as raw historical SQL. The best optimized variant retrieves both cards and raw SQL, scoring $9.00\%$ versus $6.33\%$ (p-value $0.12$) for the comparable baseline on a held-out $N{=}300$ subset, using retrieved context and harness changes but no agentic loop.
2608.22830.paper_summary_zh: 部署大型語言模型（LLMs）以進行企業文本轉 SQL 的瓶頸不在於模型本身，而在於能夠傳遞給它的上下文：業務邏輯跨越數千個表格，沒有任何模型能夠一次性處理完整的目錄。我們主張，最有效的介入點因此是模型所消耗的\emph{知識庫上下文}，而這個上下文應該是從歷史使用中\emph{構建}出來的，而不是作為固定輸入進行調整。使用查詢-DAG 分解——這是企業基準如 BEAVER 標註的同一類中介，這裡從生產 SQL 中恢復——我們比較了預言者查詢圖與檢索的知識庫上下文的價值。在這次消融實驗中，檢索的知識庫上下文在添加到完整的預言者圖時提供了最大的邊際改進。在此基礎上，我們優化了一個蒸餾程序，將歷史查詢配置文件轉換為可重用的 SQL 參考卡。在一個來自主要在線零售商的 5176 條生產查詢的基準測試中，優化這些上下文工件所帶來的增益（${\sim}12$--$25\%$ AST 相似度）大於優化檢索工具（${\sim}3$--$12\%$）。在公共 BEAVER 基準中，由於缺乏我們內部環境中可用的生產使用信號，情況則更為混合：僅表卡的表現與原始歷史 SQL 大致相同。最佳的優化變體同時檢索卡片和原始 SQL，在持出 $N{=}300$ 子集的可比基準上得分 $9.00\%$ 對 $6.33\%$（p 值 $0.12$），使用檢索的上下文和工具變更，但沒有代理循環。
